newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport cargo slows to 1.3pct growth in year.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport cargo slows to 1.3pct growth in year.

text.p: Total air cargo flown to and from Frankfurt airport (FRA) in April slowed to 1.3 percent year-on-year growth, airport authority figures showed.
Cargo volumes weakened in the second half of the month with changed summer schedules causing a 19 percent fall in transit cargo, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.

"The decline in domestic cargo was in contrast to continued growth in foreign volumes, in particular for North America, the Middle and Far East as well as in arrivals from Europe, North Africa and Asia," it added.
